title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

Job Title : **Senior Quality Analyst**

Experience : **5-8 Years**

Location : Flexible / Hybrid

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented **Senior Quality Analyst** to lead quality assurance activities across enterprise application implementations and enhancements. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring delivery of high-quality software solutions through comprehensive test planning, execution, defect management, and continuous process improvement. The role requires strong expertise in both manual and automated testing, stakeholder collaboration, and Agile project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Analyze business requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and technical designs to develop comprehensive test strategies.
* Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data.
* Execute functional, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end testing activities.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution.
* Validate bug fixes and perform impact analysis for production releases.
* Ensure adherence to organizational QA standards, testing processes, and best practices.

Agile Delivery Support

* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and Project Managers to ensure quality throughout the SDLC.
* Review acceptance criteria and provide early feedback on requirements to improve testability.

Test Automation

* Identify opportunities for test automation and support automation framework implementation.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts where applicable.
* Ensure regression testing coverage is optimized through automation.

Reporting & Governance

* Prepare test execution reports, quality dashboards, defect metrics, and release readiness reports.
* Provide quality status updates to project leadership and stakeholders.
* Support root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.

Production Support

* Participate in production validation activities and release verification.
* Assist teams in troubleshooting production issues and validating fixes.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in software testing and quality assurance.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience with defect management tools such as **Azure DevOps**, **Jira**, or similar platforms.

Technical Skills

Mandatory

* Manual Testing
* Functional Testing
* Regression Testing
* Integration Testing
* API Testing
* Defect Management
* Test Planning & Execution
* Agile/Scrum Methodology
* Azure DevOps or Jira

Preferred

* Salesforce Testing
* CRM Application Testing
* .NET Application Testing
* SQL Querying and Database Validation
* REST API Testing using Postman
* Test Automation using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress
* Performance Testing knowledge (JMeter preferred)

Preferred Certifications

* ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL)
* Certified Agile Tester
* Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce Business Analyst Certification (preferred for Salesforce projects)

Key Competencies

* Strong stakeholder management
* Attention to detail
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Leadership and mentoring capabilities
* Quality-first mindset
* Strong documentation skills

Nice to Have

* Experience testing Salesforce Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, or ITSM implementations.
* Experience working with enterprise integrations and middleware platforms.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience mentoring junior QA team members.

**Compensation**
----------------

Estimated Pay Range:  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------------------------

*At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*  
  
*Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.*  
  
*We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

title: PC -1526 - Sr. QA Engineer/QA Lead
description:
**QA Engineer – Manual + Automation**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a skilled QA Engineer (Manual + Automation) to join the engineering team at Softobiz supporting the Pickles web transformation project. You will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies that span manual, automation, API, regression, and release validation testing across the platform.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with both manual testing practices and modern test automation frameworks, with a solid understanding of CI/CD integration, API testing, and end-to-end quality assurance across web applications. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure the highest levels of product quality and a reliable, release-ready codebase throughout the development lifecycle.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Manual Testing**

* Design, write, and execute detailed test cases and test plans for functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing of web applications.
* Perform cross-browser and cross-device compatibility testing to ensure consistent user experiences.
* Conduct end-to-end manual validation of user stories and acceptance criteria, working closely with product and design stakeholders.
* Identify, document, and track defects using issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira), ensuring clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and timely resolution.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure quality is built into every stage of the process.

**Automation Testing**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for web applications using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or equivalent.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable automated test scripts in TypeScript or JavaScript.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) to enable continuous testing on every build.
* Monitor and analyze automated test results, investigate flaky tests, and maintain a high level of automation coverage across critical user journeys.
* Contribute to test strategy discussions and advocate for automation-first approaches where appropriate.

**API Testing**

* Design and execute comprehensive API test suites for RESTful services using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, or equivalent.
* Validate request/response payloads, status codes, authentication flows, and error handling across API contracts.
* Collaborate with backend developers to review API specifications and flag potential issues before implementation.
* Automate API test collections and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous API quality validation.

**Regression Testing**

* Own and maintain the regression test suite, ensuring comprehensive coverage of core platform functionality.
* Execute full and targeted regression cycles ahead of each release, clearly documenting scope, results, and sign-off status.
* Identify areas of the application most susceptible to regression risk and priorities automation coverage accordingly.
* Track and report regression metrics over time to support continuous quality improvement.

**Release Validation**

* Act as the quality gate for each release, coordinating release validation activities across environments (dev, staging, production).
* Prepare and execute release checklists, smoke tests, and sanity checks to confirm production readiness.
* Work with DevOps and engineering leads to validate deployments and sign off on go-live readiness.
* Document release test outcomes and communicate clearly to stakeholders on quality status and any outstanding risks.

**Quality Engineering & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with developers, product managers, and designers to define acceptance criteria and establish a shared definition of done.
* Champion a quality-first culture within the team through proactive defect prevention, shift-left testing practices, and continuous feedback.
* Maintain up-to-date test documentation, including test plans, test reports, and traceability matrices.
* Mentor junior QA team members and contribute to QA best practices and internal knowledge sharing.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**DomainSkills & TechnologiesMust / Preferred**

  

Manual Testing

Test case design, exploratory testing, UAT, regression, cross-browser testing

**Must**

  

Automation Framework

Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium; Page Object Model (POM); reusable test architecture

**Must**

  

Languages

TypeScript, JavaScript

**Must**

  

API Testing

Postman, RestAssured or equivalent; REST API validation, contract testing

**Must**

  

CI/CD Integration

GitHub Actions or equivalent; integrating test suites into build pipelines

**Must**

  

Defect Management

Jira or equivalent; defect lifecycle, severity classification, reporting

**Must**

  

Test Management

TestRail, Zephyr, or equivalent; test plans, traceability matrices, test reporting

**Must**

  

Regression Testing

Regression suite ownership, coverage strategy, scheduled regression cycles

**Must**

  

Release Validation

Release checklists, smoke/sanity testing, environment validation, go-live sign-off

**Must**

  

Performance Testing

JMeter, k6, or equivalent for load and performance validation

**Preferred**

  

Security Testing

Basic OWASP awareness, vulnerability scanning basics

**Preferred**

  

Cloud & DevOps

AWS or Azure – deployment environments; Docker basics for local test environments

**Preferred**

  

AI / Dev Tools

AI-assisted test generation (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor)

**Preferred**

  

Observability

Log analysis, AppInsights, or ELK stack for identifying failures post-deploy

**Preferred**

**QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–7 years of hands-on QA experience covering both manual and automation testing in production web application environments.
* Demonstrable experience building and maintaining automation frameworks using Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* Hands-on experience with API testing using Postman or equivalent – this is a mandatory requirement.
* Proven ownership of regression test suites and release validation activities in an agile delivery context.
* Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams – ideally in a global or client-facing delivery context.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* ISTQB Foundation Level or Advanced Level (Test Analyst / Technical Test Analyst)
* Playwright or Cypress official certifications (where available)
* Any relevant cloud or DevOps certifications (AWS, Azure, GitHub Actions)

**SOFT SKILLS & CULTURAL FIT**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills – able to articulate test findings, risk assessments, and quality status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working independently during IST hours while collaborating with international clients and team members across different time zones.
* High sense of ownership over quality outcomes – proactively identifies gaps and drives issues to resolution without constant supervision.
* Collaborative team player who actively participates in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and cross-functional quality discussions.
* Curious, growth-oriented mindset – proactively upskills on new testing tools, frameworks, and AI-enabled QA practices.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Opportunity to work on real-world product engineering for Pickles – one of Australia’s leading vehicle remarketing platforms.
* Exposure to modern web architectures and the full software delivery lifecycle in a fast-moving, collaborative engineering team.
* Technically strong team with a culture of code quality, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.
* Competitive compensation, professional development support, and access to emerging AI development tools.
* Flexible working arrangements – hybrid options available depending on location.

**About Softobiz**

Softobiz is a technology firm. We build software and run dedicated offshore teams — Global Capability Centres — for a portfolio of international clients across multiple markets. We are looking for an Operations Manager to run the operations of the whole business: the delivery

engine behind our GCCs, and the day-to-day running of the company itself. Just as important, we want someone who treats operations as something to be continuously sharpened — not just kept running. A core part of this role is reviewing how we work, redesigning processes that are manual or inefficient, automating them, and bringing AI deeply into how the operation runs. We are a technology company and we expect our operations to reflect that. Strategy and commercials sit with leadership; your job is to make the operation run, make it run *better* over time, report on it clearly, and escalate the right things at the right time. You will have an operations support resource handling day-to-day administrative and coordination tasks beneath you.

**For more information about our solutions and organization, visit** **www.softobiz.com****, Follow us on** **Twitter****,** **Facebook****, and** **LinkedIn****.**

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
**Role** **Purpose** :

We are looking for a technically strong QA Automation Engineer / SDET to build and maintain automated testing solutions for data-intensive applications and systems. The role requires a strong programming foundation in Python, hands-on experience with Pytest, PySpark and SQL, and the ability to understand application code, develop reliable automated tests, and leverage AI agents to improve testing efficiency.

This is an automation-first role, with approximately 85–90% of testing expected to be automated and minimal manual testing. The successful candidate will contribute to scalable test frameworks, data validation, automated regression coverage, and AI-enabled testing workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain automated test suites, targeting approximately 85–90% automation coverage with minimal reliance on manual testing.

* Develop robust and reusable test automation frameworks using Python and Pytest.

* Write and maintain automated test cases covering functional, integration, API, regression and data-processing scenarios.

* Use PySpark to validate data transformations, processing logic, data quality and expected outputs across data-intensive workflows.

* Write SQL queries to validate application data, verify database states, identify  
  inconsistencies and reconcile expected versus actual results.

* Integrate Python, Pytest, PySpark and SQL into automated validation workflows wherever appropriate.

* Understand application code, test existing implementations, investigate failures and identify defects through code-level analysis.

* Design reusable test utilities, fixtures, assertions, test-data management mechanisms and failure-reporting capabilities.

* Leverage AI agents to support test-case generation, test automation, code analysis, failure investigation and other relevant QA workflows.

* Create, maintain and improve  
  SKILL.md files defining instructions, workflows, tools and reusable capabilities for AI agents.

* Evaluate AI-generated test cases and code for correctness, reliability, maintainability and adequate test coverage.

* Integrate automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines and support repeatable regression validation.

* Collaborate with developers, data engineers and other stakeholders to understand requirements, review code, investigate defects and improve overall software quality.

* Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual effort through automation, reusable components and AI-assisted workflows.

  

**Skills and Experience:**

  

* Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, including writing maintainable code, reusable utilities, functions, modules and debugging logic.

* Practical experience with Pytest, including test design, fixtures, parametrisation, assertions, test organisation and failure handling.

* Hands-on experience with PySpark, including validating distributed data-processing logic, transformations and expected data outputs.

* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, filtering, subqueries and data validation across relational databases.

* Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks rather than relying primarily on manual test execution.

* Ability to connect automated test execution with backend or database validation and assert expected results.

* Ability to read and understand application code, trace execution logic, investigate failures and distinguish application defects from test issues.

* Practical experience leveraging AI agents or AI-assisted development workflows for coding, testing, debugging or task automation.

* Ability to write and maintain Markdown-based SKILL.md files for defining reusable AI-agent skills, instructions or workflows.

* Experience with version control, preferably Git, and automated execution through CI/CD pipelines.

  

**Must Have skills:**

* Experience with Selenium or Playwright for UI automation, where relevant to the application.
* API automation using Python libraries and tools.

* Experience testing data-intensive applications, distributed processing workflows or data platforms.

* Experience with automated data-quality checks, reconciliation and database integrity validation.

* Familiarity with Docker, Linux environments and CI/CD tooling.

* Experience evaluating AI/LLM outputs, validating generated code or building AI-assisted testing workflows.

* Experience working in Agile development environments.

title: Software Tester / QA Engineer

title: Intermediate Software Tester - Travel Domain
description:
**Job Summary**:  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive **Intermediate Software Tester** to join our QA team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in **both Manual and Automation testing**, be confident in **creating comprehensive test cases**, and demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You will play a key role in ensuring product quality and improving the overall testing process.**Key Responsibilities**:

* Design, write, and execute **manual test cases** based on functional and non-functional requirements.
* Develop and maintain **automated test scripts** using \[mention tools like Selenium, TestNG, etc. as applicable].
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product managers to understand system requirements.
* Conduct **regression testing**, **smoke testing**, and **exploratory testing** as needed.
* Identify, log, track, and verify bugs using tools like **JIRA**, **Bugzilla**, etc.
* Participate in **test planning**, **effort estimation**, and **risk analysis** activities.
* Analyze test results and provide actionable insights for improving software quality.
* Maintain test documentation, including **test plans**, **test cases**, and **test summary reports**.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**:

* 3–6 years of experience in **software testing**.
* Strong understanding of **SDLC** and **STLC**.
* Proficient in both **Manual testing** and **Automation testing**.
* Experience in writing and maintaining **test cases** and **test scripts**.
* Hands-on experience with one or more test automation tools (e.g., **Selenium**, **JUnit**, **TestNG**, **Postman** for API testing).
* Familiarity with test management and bug tracking tools (e.g., **JIRA**, **TestRail**, **QTest**).
* Good knowledge of **bug life cycle** and **defect tracking**.
* Basic knowledge of **SQL** and **API testing** is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

**Preferred Qualifications** (Nice to have):

* Exposure to **performance testing tools** (e.g., JMeter).
* ISTQB certification or equivalent is a plus.
* Experience working with B2B/B2C travel portals or booking engines is a plus.
* Familiarity with GDS, NDC, or LCC integrations is a plus.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Quality Analyst
description:
Job Summary:  
We are seeking a skilled Test Engineer to lead the testing and quality assurance efforts for our products. As a Test Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and executing comprehensive test cases, identifying and reporting defects, and ensuring overall quality of the product. You will play a critical role in ensuring that our products meet the highest standards of quality and performance.

Key Responsibilities:  
· Develop and maintain a comprehensive testing strategy that encompasses all aspects of the product, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing.  
· Work closely with the development team to integrate QA processes into the software development lifecycle, ensuring that quality is considered at all stages.  
· Oversee the selection and implementation of testing tools and technologies.  
· Analyze test results, identify and report defects, and work with the development team to ensure timely resolution.  
· Continuously assess and improve testing processes and practices to enhance product quality and team efficiency.  
· Stay up to date with the latest testing methodologies, tools, and industry’s best practices.

Required Qualifications:  
· 3-5 years of experience.  
· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.  
· Knowledge of any automation/performance or security testing tool is an added advantage.  
· Knowledge of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum) and their impact on the QA process.  
· Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with keen attention to detail.  
· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.  
· Work closely with the development team to integrate QA processes into the software development lifecycle, ensuring that quality is considered at all stages

Work Location: In person

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

A technically proficient quality assurance professional responsible for designing and executing advanced testing strategies, building scalable automation frameworks, and ensuring software reliability across platforms. The Senior SQA Engineer collaborates closely with development teams, contributes to continuous integration efforts, and drives quality improvements through deep expertise in testing tools, coding, and agile methodologies.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement robust test automation frameworks using tools like Selenium, TestNG, or Cypress.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for UI, API, and backend systems.
* Perform deep functional, regression, integration, and performance testing.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure testability and quality in code.
* Conduct root cause analysis and provide detailed defect reports.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
* Validate data integrity through database testing using SQL/DB2.
* Participate in code reviews and provide QA feedback.
* Execute security and compatibility testing across platforms.
* Maintain test documentation and contribute to QA process improvements.

  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* Any Graduate or Post Graduate with minium 4-8 years of prior relevant experience, or equivalent experience

**Skills And Competencies:**

  

* Languages: Java, Python, JavaScript, HTML5, XML, SQL.
* API Testing: Postman, REST-assured, SoapUI.
* Performance Testing: JMeter, LoadRunner.
* Version Control: Git, GitHub, Bitbucket.
* Database: DB2, MySQL, Oracle – strong SQL query skills.
* Frameworks: TDD, BDD (Cucumber).
* Soft Skills: Analytical thinking, problem-solving, attention to detail, strong communication.

  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Senior QA Analyst.
description:
The Senior QA Analyst is responsible for the design and execution of test plans to ensure new functionality, enhancements, or bug  
fixes meet business and/or functional requirements. In addition, identifies whether products or enhancements are functional, reliable, performant and meet the intended use cases as well as end user expectations. The Senior QA Analyst also provides  
leadership and mentorship to other QA Analysts on the team to drive efficiencies and best practices.  
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** 4 Year / Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, business, engineering, or STEM related disciplines  
 5\-7 years of creating and executing test plans for software solutions as well as designing and executing best practices  
 Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions that are then presented to cross\-  
functional departments as needed  
 Working understanding of software developed in a Microsoft environment using Visual Studio, ASP.Net, C\# and SQL Server  
 Demonstrated ability to design and develop repeatable processes that improve existing software testing processes  
 Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills  
 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills  
 Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills  
 Working understanding of Microsoft DevOps preferred  
 Must be self\-motivated and able to adapt to a rapidly changing environment

Pay: Up to ₹80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* QA: 3 years (Preferred)
* ASP.NET: 3 years (Preferred)
* C\#: 2 years (Preferred)
* Visual Studio: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

description:

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Perform end\-to\-end quality assurance testing of Power BI reports, dashboards, and data outputs prior to business UAT and production release.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across source systems, data models, and report outputs.
* Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and validation scenarios based on business requirements and defined KPIs.
* Conduct functional testing to ensure reports meet business logic, calculations, filters, and expected user behaviour.
* Perform data reconciliation and root cause analysis for discrepancies, working closely with BI Engineers and Data Engineers to resolve issues.
* Serve as the primary QA gatekeeper, ensuring all reports and changes are thoroughly validated before release to business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with BI Engineering to validate new reports, enhancements, and data fixes in development and staging environments before business sharing.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to support structured UAT readiness, including preparing test datasets, scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
* Document testing results, defects, and resolutions, maintaining traceability and audit readiness.
* Ensure adherence to BI standards, governance practices, and data quality frameworks across all deliverables.
* Identify and proactively drive improvements in QA processes, testing coverage, and data validation practices.
* Support ongoing monitoring of production reports by validating data discrepancies, defects, and performance issues.

**Qualifications \& Experience**
================================

**Required**

* 3–5\+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Quality Assurance, preferably within a BI or data environment.
* Hands\-on experience testing Power BI reports and dashboards (Tableau or Looker experience is an asset).
* Strong understanding of data validation, data quality principles, and reconciliation techniques.
* Proficiency in SQL for data querying, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Solid understanding of data models, ETL processes, and reporting logic within BI ecosystems.
* Experience creating and executing test cases, QA documentation, and defect tracking.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes of data or logic issues.
* Ability to translate business requirements into structured QA validation scenarios.
* Familiarity with UAT processes, release workflows, and agile delivery environments.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
* High attention to detail, with a strong focus on accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data outputs.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in a Power BI\-centric BI Engineering team working with certified semantic models and structured deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with Jira for defect tracking and release management.
* Understanding of data governance frameworks and BI delivery best practices.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
**Company Description**


McFadyen Digital is the leading advisor and implementer of eCommerce Marketplace solutions. During 15 years of implementing marketplaces, we’ve built dozens of platforms that cumulatively generate billions of dollars of gross merchandise value (GMV). We’re honored to have supported 10% of the Fortune 500 with their digital marketplace initiatives. Over 250 global brands like ABB, AB InBev, ACCO, Albertsons, American Red Cross, American Eagle Outfitters, US Army, US Agriculture Dept, (and many more) have entrusted their digital transformations to McFadyen. We operate global offices across the US, Brazil, and India. McFadyen Digital has been a trusted employer for over 35 years and believes that people are the most important part of our company. We’re proud of our Great Place to Work certification.

**Learn more about us at our website:** **www.mcfadyen.com**

**Job Description**


We are looking for a Senior QA Analyst Level 1 to work with our amazing team.


Are you a good tester? Do you enjoy solving problems? Do you love ecommerce? If you answer yes to these questions, McFadyen has an opportunity for you!


Experience: 5–7 years and Excellent Communication Skills Mandatory

**Top 5 Responsibilities**

* **AI\-Assisted Test Design \& Execution**
* **Playwright\-Based Test Automation**
* **Test Planning \& Functional QA**
* **Web, Responsive \& User Experience Testing**
* **Defect Management \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

**Additional Must have Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI tools such as **Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent AI assistants** as part of day\-to\-day QA activities.
* Use AI to analyze requirements, generate and refine test scenarios, identify edge cases, generate test data, analyze defects, and improve testing efficiency.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs rather than blindly relying on them.
* Develop, maintain, and execute **Playwright\-based automated tests** for functional and regression coverage.
* Use AI coding/testing assistants to accelerate automation development and improve automation coverage.
* Ensure automated tests remain aligned with verified application behavior and requirements.
* Translate requirements, user stories, and engineering notes into structured test scenarios, test cases, and test plans.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and release testing.
* Use requirements/tickets as the source of truth and avoid making assumptions about intended behavior.
* Test content\-heavy web applications across **desktop, tablet, and mobile**.
* Validate search, navigation, content rendering, filters, editors, threads, comments, notifications, links, permissions, and other user journeys.
* Identify usability, functional, content, and responsive issues.
* Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects with clear steps, expected vs. actual results, severity, and supporting evidence.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve defects, address blockers, and support release readiness.
* Clearly distinguish confirmed defects from requirement/design ambiguity and escalate where clarification is required.
**Top 5 — Good to Have Responsibilities**

* **AI Agentic QA \& Workflow Development**
* Experience creating or using AI\-powered QA workflows/agents for requirement analysis, test generation, UI exploration, test\-data generation, defect analysis, or test\-result analysis.
* Exposure to **Playwright MCP** or similar agentic testing approaches.
* **API \& Technical Testing**
* Experience with API testing and browser Developer Tools.
* Ability to inspect network requests, API responses, console errors, DOM state, and other technical information to troubleshoot issues.
* **QA Metrics \& Quality Analytics**
* Track metrics such as test coverage, automation coverage, execution trends, defect leakage, defect trends, regression effectiveness, and release quality.
* Use AI to identify patterns, anomalies, and recurring quality issues.
* **Programming \& Automation Engineering**
* Working knowledge of **JavaScript/TypeScript or Python**.
* Understanding of automation framework structure, reusable components, dynamic test data, and test maintainability.
* **CI/CD \& DevOps**
* Familiarity with **Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions/Jenkins, Docker**, and CI/CD concepts.
* Ability to execute and troubleshoot automated tests as part of CI/CD pipelines.
**Rest — Additional / Nice to Have**

* Experience testing **AI/LLM applications**, including response validation, hallucination testing, RAG testing, and AI evaluation.
* Experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools.
* Experience developing reusable AI prompts, skills, agents, and workflows.
* Experience with AI\-assisted test\-case and automation generation.
* Exposure to performance testing and tools such as JMeter/BlazeMeter.
* Experience with Selenium, Cypress, or other automation frameworks.
* Experience with Kubernetes.
* Experience building QA dashboards and quality analytics.
* Experience using AI for test\-result and production\-data analysis.
* Prior experience in a startup or fast\-iterating product environment.

**What We Can Offer You:**

* A career in digital marketplaces and platform businesses.
* A career with first movers who are deploying new business models and strategies worldwide.
* A career with thought leaders who literally wrote the book on Marketplace Best Practices.
* A career in the fast\-paced world of retail eCommerce.
* A career in a flat management structure without a rigid hierarchy and bureaucracy.
* A career in a culture that rewards creativity and innovation, risk\-taking and teamwork.

**Additional Information:**

**Our Core Values:** Caring, Adaptable, Proactive Ownership, Empowering Clients

**Keywords:** Quality Assurance, E\-commerce, Marketplace, Software Testing, Test Scripts, Bug Reporting, Playwright, Selenium, Automation Testing, API Testing, Postman, JMeter, Claude, Generative AI, AI\-Assisted Testing

**eCommerce \& Marketplace Platforms:** Adobe Commerce (Magento), Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), SAP Hybris, Mirakl, ChannelAdvisor, IBM WebSphere Commerce, BigCommerce, Shopify Plus, commercetools, Oracle Commerce, Elastic Path, Spryker

**Technology \& Tools:** CRM (Salesforce), SaaS Sales, PIM (Product Information Management), CPQ (Configure Price Quote), CMS (Content Management Systems), OMS (Order Management Systems), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), BI Tools (Business Intelligence)

**QA Technology \& Tools:** Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Postman, SoapUI, JMeter, JIRA, CI/CD, Test Automation Frameworks, Claude, Generative AI Tools, AI\-Assisted Testing Tools
